description: This file contains transformation logic for converting OpenAI /v1/embeddings format to Jina AI's /v1/embeddings format, including configuration, request/response transformation, environment validation, and error handling.

classes.name: JinaAIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Jina AI embeddings, providing methods for URL construction, request/response transformation, environment validation, and error handling.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the class configuration as a dictionary of class variables.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters, e.g., 'dimensions'.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default OpenAI parameters to optional parameters for the request.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Provides provider info including API base URL and API key, possibly from secrets.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for the embedding request.

methods.name: transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format expected by the Jina AI API, handling base64-encoded images and text.

methods.name: transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Processes the raw HTTP response into an EmbeddingResponse object, with logging.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and validates request headers, including authorization.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns a custom error class instance for handling API errors.
